'''34 Besh''' was an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] on board the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Munificent-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] which served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where they fought the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the Clone Wars ended the ''Sa Nalaor'' fled Republic space and crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. During the crash several crew members attempted to abandon ship in escape pod ''34 Besh'', crashing in a crevasse on Cholganna's surface, where the pod would remain half buried for [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

==History==
''34 Besh'' was the designation of an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] on board the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] where the Confederacy fought the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the war ended the ''Sa Nalaor'' attempted to flee Republic space but ended up crashing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. Just prior to the ship crashing three [[Human/Legends|Human]] and two [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] crew members attempted to use the escape pod to avoid being caught in the accident. Whilst in the pod they received a message from the ''Sa Nalaor's'' [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Rel Harsol]], who condemned them for abandoning ship, after which they cursed the captain for bringing them to the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], as well as [[Cratala]], a passenger aboard the ''Sa Nalaor''. The pod crashed into the surface of Cholganna at the bottom of a steep crevasse, where it half buried itself in the ground about five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above a brackish pond. At least one Human [[Unidentified Human Sa Nalaor crew member|member]] of the pod's crew did not survive the landing and their body was left strapped into its seat once the rest of the crew got out.<ref name="BTR" />

Many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the pod was heavily rusted and covered in [[Color/Legends|reddish]] thorny [[Vine/Legends|vines]], as well as infested with a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Unidentified green bug|green bug]]. Several [[Bone/Legends|skeletal]] [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], damaged [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Blood/Legends|blood]] and scraps of Confederacy crew uniform as well as a [[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]] skeleton were found around the pod, with the Nexu showing signs of having been killed by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The pod's records of the voice traffic between its crew and Harsol, its coordinates of launch and a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of the crew during flight, were still intact and retrievable.<ref name="BTR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the Galactic Civil War, the pod was investigated by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who had been hired by the tech salvage company [[IsoTech]] to find the ''Sa Nalaor''. After removing the threat of the green bugs, which had harmful stingers, they recovered all intact data from the pod.<ref name="BTR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Description==
The pod was relatively large for a escape pod, and had one hatch on its side. It's designation of ''34 [[Besh/Legends|besh]]'' was also written on the exterior. The pod was capable of keeping recordings of incoming and outgoing voice traffic as well as its coordinates of launch and a holographic recording of its interior during flight. There were several seats in the interior where crew could strap themselves in.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The escape pod first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The escape pod is a potential location which players can investigate on the surface of Cholganna while searching the remains of the ''Sa Nalaor''.
